title: A ring map is smooth iff the morphism of spectra is smooth
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $\operatorname{Spec}\varphi:\operatorname{Spec}S\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ the induced morphism of affine schemes [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then $\operatorname{Spec}\varphi$ is smooth in the sense of [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] (locally of finite presentation and formally smooth) if and only if the ring map $\varphi$ is smooth in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map] ($S$ finitely presented over $R$, $H_1(L_{S/R})=0$, $\Omega_{S/R}$ finite projective).
